versions.changelog:
Initial release of tex2docx — LaTeX to Word converter.

- Converts academic LaTeX (.tex) files to Word (.docx) with IEEE-style formatting
- Preserves editable OMML equations, native Word tables, embedded figures, and bibliography
- Supports two-column layout, Times New Roman font, and paragraph/table formatting
- Includes Chinese (ctex) document support for section titles, headers, and text
- Requires Python, pandoc, and a few Python packages (python-docx, lxml, pypandoc_binary)
- Provides a verification script to check output quality and LaTeX residue
